title: Brownies
description: Just a silly little texture pack to change the cake to a brownie!
body:
This is just a texture pack to replace the minecraft cake with a brownie.

Please give suggestions on what I should make next! I am most likely free so any suggestions are welcome! And if you have any ways to make them better, feel free! But I would want to see it so i can improve my skills when doing this sort of thing.

If you want the texture of the item to be the cake you will need EMF and ETF to make the item the correct model
